notes.title: Lovely V140.2
notes.content:
V140.2

Hello everyone! We've just pushed a new v140.2 build to fix some essential and not-so-essential bugs. 

Fixed : Mods : Custom objects were inappropriately flagged as causing infinite recursion. Thanks, Egan!
Fixed : The tutorial step "select the tab to open your bot tracker" wouldn't complete if the bot list was already open.
Fixed : An error would appear when the mouse hovered over some Cut Grass while the player was engaged with a Wheelbarrow holding a Pitchfork. Yeah. I know.
Fixed : Using Undo after deleting a Blueprint would reinstate the Blueprint but also show it as completed. This could lead to a corrupted save file.
Fixed : when adding an upgrade to a bot with upgrade of the same type, holding ctrl on a bot would result in old upgrade still being highlighted. Thanks, Koloxlo!
Fixed : A building couldn't be flipped without first moving it. Thanks, Koloxlo!
Fixed : A flipped Spaceport had both its inputs and outputs on the same place. Thanks, Koloxlo!
Fixed : Save file names could go over 50 characters in length and they shouldn't.
Fixed : A bot taught to load a Carriage using a Cart could sometimes get stuck not Finding any Carriages.

Enjoy!

notes.title: QoLly Good Show!
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support and your patience, you beautiful, vocal, warm community of Automates.

Based on your feedback so far, not to mention what we learned from making [i]Autonauts vs Piratebots[/i], we now have a cache of QoLs and fixes for [i]Original Autonauts[/i] (AKA "[i]Originauts[/i]") burning a metaphorical hole in our pocket. KA-THUNK! That's the sound of that lovely hot lump - a new Version 139.1 - falling out on to the BETAS branch, so opt in if you haven't already.

Key update chunks include:
[list]
[*] Loads of Bot Database boosts, such as the scope to share and append programs between Bots, and the addition of folders so you can more easily manage your cunning code.
[*] Heaps of changes to Signs, including a new tab for easy Sign management.
[*] Tonnes of revisions to Bot programs.
[*] A bunch of Bot-related improvements, like better routefinding, and Bot Tracker filters and searching.
[*] Oodles of general enhancements.
[*] Masses of bug fixes.
[/list]
The full Change Log can be found [url=https://www.denki.co.uk/AutonautsChangeLog.txt]HERE[/url].

Some of these QoLS are literally game-changers!

Oh! Oh! Better still, for the next four weeks, our priority is focusing on QoLs for [i]Originauts[/i], so if there's anything about the game that tickles you or prickles you, now's the time to tell us. If it's viable, we'll address it before we move on to our new development phase afterwards.

Can't wait to collude with you all to make [i]Autonauts[/i] as delicious as possible!

Happy travels!

Garinaut and Aaronaut

notes.title: Important Survival Mode Update
notes.content:
Ahoy, me hearties! Thanks so much for all your support and patience while Aaron and I have been swabbing the poop deck and rigging the masts of the good ship Autonauts. It's almost time for us to weigh anchor, hoist the mainsail, and begin exploring the Bot Seas once again!

It's been quiet lately… too quiet, we know. BUT! There's been lots going on behind the scenes we can't share until everything's finalised for fear of jinxing it. We're not quite ready to announce everything we have coming up just yet, but what we can say is that 2022 is shaping up to be a big year for fans of Autonauts. 

However, ahead of all the good news we'll be announcing later on we felt it was important to update everyone about what's happening with the “Survival Mode” we promised as a free update for Autonauts a while back. The good news is that we have been working hard on it and it will be coming out soon, but the bad news is it isn’t going to be free.

Why's that? Well, in truth we didn't think this through. We expected to be spending a few months making it, but it's ended up taking us almost two years to finish. What started as "just an extra mode" for Autonauts has grown into an entirely new Autonauts experience of its own, because Aaron and I wanted to create the absolute best game we possibly could. At times it felt like we'd never finish it, but at last we see the end in sight. Now we're just a few more months away from finishing. We're both REALLY pleased with what we've made, and we're even more excited to share it with you all so you can enjoy playing it after waiting patiently for so long.

Of course, we do understand how deeply disappointed some of you will be that we won’t be able to bring new free content to the original Autonauts game for now, and we are genuinely sorry about that.  It's not a decision we've taken lightly, but there really is just the two of us making Autonauts and we miscalculated how much extra work it would take to create “Survival” mode. All our energy has gone into this new version, so we hope you understand and will continue to give us your support as we do our best to deliver the most amazing Autonauts experiences that the two of us possibly can.

We’ll be sharing more about the new Autonauts game in the coming months but in the meantime we wanted to assure all existing Autonauts players that we really appreciate the support you’ve given us so far. As a small token of that appreciation we’ve agreed with our publisher Curve that we will offer a discount to anyone who already owns the original Autonauts and wants to buy the new one when it launches - so not quite as free as we'd originally hoped, but still a whole lot of new Autonauting fun for as little as possible.

This has been a labour of love for our tiny team and we can't wait to share it with you all in just a few more short months.

notes.title: Quality AutoQOLs in the Pipeline
notes.content:
Hello Autoneers. We're still hard at work on the new Survival mode and progress is sure and steady. We know you're all keen as mustard to get your hands on it but unfortunately we still can't really give you a release date yet. Sorry ːsteamsadː In the mean time we thought we'd share with you some of the QOLs that have improved the Autonauting experience in the original modes. These will be released at the same time as Survival. 

Bot Database
* Shared scripting added. Multiple bots can subscribe to the same script and all will receive subsequent changes.
* Pressing B will now access the bot database, if it's available.
* Uploading a new script or renaming an old script will autoscroll the list to the new script.
* Data Storages can now upload/download directly to the database.
* Hovering over a script name will now show a preview of the script.
* Bot scripts can now be appended to using CTRL-click on the Download button in the Database.

Signs:
* A new tab was added for easy sign management.
* Signs can now be added to an upgrade slot.
* Signs that are being held can now be selected in Area Edit.
* Shout Sign Name button added to Sign Edit panel. 
* Pressing Z while sign is an upgrade will shout the Sign's name instead of "Go!" (if we're not holding something else that reacts to Z).
* Settings option added to allow Signs to always face the camera.
* Sign Edit options merged with Area Edit options.

General changes
* Search areas now don't get cropped to visible plots.
* When a bot uploads a Crude Storage the target bot will now autostart the new script.
* Bot List filter added (active, broken tool, dead etc).
* Clicking any instruction in the pull-out tab on the brain now adds the instruction to the end of the script.
* Clicking If/IfElse with some instructions highlighted will now auto-wrap those instructions into the If/IfElse.
* Multiple cameras added. Use numpad 1-5 keys to change between them.
* Right ALT key now works.
* When a building is moved, any bots moving to that building will change course to the new location.
* Bots now routefind on paths/roads properly.

Bug fixes
* So many bug fixes!

So, lots of improvements to the Database and Signs and plenty of general upgrades to make automating easier and more fun. Hopefully this gives everyone something to look forward to, even if they don't want to fight in Survival :smile:

Love from Gary and Aaron

Meanwhile, Aaron and I are still working hard on finishing off Survival Mode. This week we added the first of the five 'boss' characters, namely 'Long Bot Silver'. To meet (and hopefully defeat) this ruby-eyed cutlass-rattling bag o' bones, you first need get them out of their hideaway (an old lighthouse), which means overthrowing relentless mechanical minions - and demolishing Pirate Barracks to halt production of said relentless mechanical minions.

Long Bot Silver controls a Twine Factory, which doesn't sound particularly exciting until you realise it's the only place to get essential string-making technology to manufacture slings and unlock ranged weapons. Without those, your units won't be taking out any flying Pirates any time soon, that's for sure.

Indispensable defence technology hoarded by the later bosses includes pitch (surprisingly useful sticky properties) and ultimately the game-changing combo of pesticide, fertiliser and charcoal.

The free Survival Mode expansion (which, TBH, is feeling more and more like 'Conquer Mode' every day) will be released... Well, as soon as we can possibly manage!

Stay safe! Stay Autonauty!

Gary and Aaron

notes.title: Cute colony building sim Autonauts enters Age of Enlightenment in final free update
notes.content:
Autonauts, developer Denki's automation-focussed colony management sim (complete with cute robots), has now entered the Age of Enlightenment, with this latest free update bringing the game's existing post-launch content roadmapto a close.

The initial goal of Autonauts is simple enough: automate a band of adorable worker robots in order to make their new planetary home inhabitable for humans. Reaching that point, however, is considerably more challenging, requiring players to programme and manage their charges in order to first lay the groundwork for colonisation, then push their burgeoning civilisation to greater stages of advancement, unlocking new buildings, new transportation options, new tools, and new upgrades along the way.

Autonauts' Age of Enlightenment marks the third and final phase of post-launch content updates originally announced last November (and the sixth free update in total), and is focussed on bringing culture to colonists' existence, enabling players to progress through the Art stage of the in-game evolution pyramid and reach true transcendence.

The free expansion, titled ‘The Industrial Revolution’, shifts the automation emphasis to mechanise the mining of coal and metal resources to build and fuel steam-powered worlds using potent new Mk 3 Bots. Players can now create advanced railroad networks with fully-functioning trains and add their own cheats, scripts and content to the game for the world to enjoy via Steam Workshop.

Utilising a visual programming language inspired by Scratch, players can playfully program their helpers to perform basic tasks like chopping down trees to more complicated duties like baking pies, fishing, powering-up other robots and lots more - all with the aim of satisfying colonists arriving from the homeworld.

notes.title: Autonauts Patch V131 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35498354/08c0c02d860e7266b1c7d03fb4060603f52dbd3d.png[/img]

"A wild V131 has appeared"

Not much in the way of new things to play with, but lots of bug fixes. Some people have been experiencing nasty lag/delays when autosave does its thing. We've added a new Setting which lets you control or disable the autosave frequency. Use this with caution! It's not fun to lose hours of work because you forgot to save. There's also a new Quick Save using F5 to go with it. In the longer term we'll be improving the saving so that you won't notice it happening.
[list]
[*] New : Autosave setting added. Use with caution!
[*] New : Quick Save added using F5.
[*] Updated : Folk will now change level to whatever house they're in. This means they can be downsized if needed.
[*] Fixed : Chicken Coops would sometimes contain the same Chook more than once, meaning a save couldn't be loaded.
[*] Fixed : Vehicles would despawn if there were too many of them.
[*] Fixed : After deleting some storages and placing them again it wasn't possible to stack new blueprints on top.
[*] Fixed : Cereal Seed could be put into a Sand Storage.
[*] Fixed : "Until Worker Assembler Full" would exit if the bot on the output was being recharged.
[*] Fixed : Upgraded buildings would be lost when deleted.
[*] Fixed : Deleting part-finished Sandy Tracks would crash.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes the player would be unresponsive after loading a save.
[*] Fixed : Partially filled Buckets couldn't get more Fresh Water.
[*] Fixed : Bots would attempt to add turf to soil covered by buildings/flooring.
[*] Fixed : Moving and rotating some buildings out of the world would crash.
[*] Fixed : Bees could sometimes leave the world after an autosave and crash.
[*] Fixed : Bees could disappear from a Skep.
[*] Fixed : Using WASD while autosaving could cause a large jump in camera movement.
[*] Fixed : Some objects could be put into Fertiliser Storage but not make any Fertiliser.
[*] Fixed : Chooks would stop using Hen Houses when the maximum of 100 was reached.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes a converter would be stuck with full ingredients but not produce anything.
[*] Fixed : Adding a blueprint to the top of a Barrel while a Bot added water to it would crash.
[*] Fixed : Adding a blueprint to the top of a Small Silo while a Bot added sand to it would crash.
[*] Definitely fixed this time : Sometimes a Seedling Tray would show negative Tree Seeds.
[/list]
We didn't have time to add the proposed Search Area setting this time. It will have to be V132! Speaking of which V132 will include a handful of new shiny things for you to play with, so please look forward to it!

Many Thanks

notes.title: Autonauts Patch V130 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35498354/329537ad11af5a6d0af121627c322b79d0c74268.png[/img]

Hello all!

A hot, steaming V130 is fresh out the oven for you to try! The big new toy to play with is the Shout/Hear instructions. Press Z to show a bot how to shout. Then another bot can use "Until Hear" to wait until they hear the first bot "shout". Fun!
[list]
[*] New : Shout/Hear instructions added.
[*] New : Enable/disable option for Day/Night added to Settings.
[*] New : Enable/disable option for Weather added to Settings.
[*] Updated : Pumpkin Pie to need 2 Pumpkin Stew instead of 1.
[*] Updated : Apple Pie to need 3 Apple Jam and 3 Pastry instead of 1 and 1.
[*] Fixed : Dragging an object in Trade while the bot is being upgraded would crash.
[*] Fixed : Area selecting a building that's being upgraded would crash.
[*] Fixed : Moving a building while it's upgrading could crash.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes when a bot used a Rocking Chair it would crash.
[*] Fixed : When using a Sign to search for Blueprints the instruction would incorrectly say "Find Nearest Sign".
[*] Fixed : Sometimes taking an object from a bot in Trade would crash.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes Chooks get stuck in Hen Houses or can crash when loading.
[*] Fixed : Repurposed feeding bots would sometimes not find Colonists in houses.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes bots would stop working or wander off to the edge of the map.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes a bot would get stuck looking for a blueprint when it was already standing on one. Silly ol' bot.
[*] Maybe Fixed : Sometimes scything Cereal Crops or flailing Cereal will crash.
[/list]
In the next version I'm hoping to have a new feature that allows you to choose what kind of "Find Nearest" pattern you want. Every tile, every even tile, vertical strips or horizontal strips. This will solve the "my bot won't dig these tiles" problem but should also allow you to do some interesting things (like rows of tilled soil for your vegetables instance).

Until next time!

notes.title: Autonauts Patch V129 Notes
notes.content:

Hello all!

Please see below the Patch Notes for Version 129 of Autonauts.

In this version we have a couple of new things to play with along with the usual slew of fixes. We've also moved one of the Researches from level 3 to 4 because the things it unlocked required other level 4 research, and it wasn't particularly useful at level 3.

[*] New : "Pause All" added to Bot Group panel.

[*] Updated : Pressing M or Delete will now enter Edit Mode directly, instead of having to press E first.
[*] Updated : Skeps and Hives can now be deleted.
[*] Updated : Pottery Technology moved from Level 3 research to Level 4
[*] Fixed: Since 127 some people have been experiencing that their bots either stopped or wandered off (or other crazy stuff) when they load their map. 129 should now fix this. [b]You'll need to stop/start the problem bots the first time you load up but once you save again it should be all good after that.[/b]
[*] Fixed : Bots sometimes couldn't be Whistle selected when using a Wheelbarrow.
[*] Fixed : Bots using Wheelbarrows wouldn't move after loading a level.

[*] Fixed : Converters would sometimes get stuck making an object forever.

[*] Fixed : Deleting an area of buildings while a bot was building one of them could crash.
[*] Fixed : Sometimes blueprints couldn't be deleted.
[*] Fixed : Depleted Stone Resources now regenerate after 10 minutes.
[*] Fixed : Clicking the Desktop button could sometimes minimise the game so that it couldn't be shown again.

notes.title: Autonauts Patch V128 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35498354/09f96229708ecc40a28c99c6fd801233f29109cc.png[/img]

Hello all,

Please see below the Patch Notes for Version 128 of Autonauts.

This release has the first big research changes in it to help evolve Colonists from Level 3 to Level 4 more easily (sorry to all those valiantly struggling to do this). This involved moving a few researches around, changing some of their Wuv requirements as well as moving which objects are unlocked on which research. We've tried to be careful not to break anything. It may be that you were halfway through researching something but when you load up your level, it's already completed. This is normal as the thing you were researching probably now requires less Wuv. With all that said, here is the list:
[list]
[*]Updated : Crude Toy Station no longer needs power.
[*]Updated : Crude Toy Station no longer needs Box Frame to build.
[*]Updated : Changed ingredients of Cauldron from Crude Metal Plate to Metal Ore, Clay and Crude Torch (and Sticks).
[*]Updated : Moved Crude Data Storage to first Robotics research (from second) and it's now made on Crude Workbench (as well as Good Workbench). 
[*]Fixed : A bot was able to change a workbench recipe when there were ingredients on it, and it shouldn't.
[*]Fixed : Mousing over a converter while a bot changed the recipe would crash.
[*]Fixed : Sometime loading a level would result in "item with save key already added -1" error.
[*]Fixed : Clicking Max Area when adjusting a Sign's area didn't work.
[*]Fixed : A Direction Sign's area couldn't be changed.
[*]Fixed : Adding a Bee Nest to a Skep and moving it would leave an invisible bee behind that blocked building editing
[*]Fixed : Bees going to a Flower pot would crash.
[*]Fixed : Watering Cans can't take/add from a Barrel.
[*]Fixed : Bots could sometimes not find objects or tiles
[/list]
Phew! Still plenty of bugs to go but we're getting there :)

Many Thanks
